summary: Industrial estate car park, no homes, nearly flat, full of staff cars.

best_section.where: North edge of the factory car park off Meiers Road, in front of the yard

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by factories and warehouses; nearest mapped building is non-residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Open sealed lot with a clear strip along the north edge; avoid blocking the yard and truck access.
drivers.traffic: Delivery trucks and staff movement likely by day; probably quiet at night.
drivers.convention: Lot is full of parked cars; one mapped bay is permit-only.
